summary: Comprehensive backend (15 pytest cases) and frontend (Playwright) testing of Cerebral Cortex. All 15 backend tests passed including real Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.5 deliberations (Senate single-call ~30s, Forge multi-call classifier+witnesses+synthesis ~30s). Frontend e2e flow verified: landing page with 5 lobes, all 4 chamber pages rendering councils, full Senate deliberation flow → verdict → save → archive → /verdict/:id retrieval, About page, Forge ForgeQuadrant keyword preview lighting up Court Room when 'wife' is typed. No console or page errors anywhere.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend cortex_service.deliberate_forge: if classifier returns chambers but ALL witness calls fail, RuntimeError is raised; consider adding default fallback so user gets at least one verdict even if multiple chambers fail.

Frontend CortexSVG: each lobe is a <g> with a <motion.path>. Playwright auto-click center may land outside the actual painted region for asymmetric/split lobes (boardroom, courtroom). Users clicking on the visible lobe will work, but you may want to set pointer-events explicitly on the path so the click target equals the visual area.

server.py /api/deliberate persists verdict immediately even when not saved; this is intentional (so /api/verdicts/{id} can retrieve unsaved drafts), but consider TTL cleanup for unsaved drafts to keep the collection lean.
No rate limiting or cost guard on /api/deliberate. Each call is a real Claude Sonnet 4.5 invocation; The Forge fires up to 6 LLM calls. Adding a per-archive_id rate limit would protect against abuse.
No tests for Anthropic client failure modes (timeout, malformed JSON). Currently 502 is returned via chamber.error message — verified by code review only.
test_credentials: n/a — no auth in this app; per-browser localStorage archive id only
seed_data_creation: Each backend test run creates one Senate verdict and one Forge verdict under archive_id=test-archive-cortex-<random8>. Senate verdict is saved then unsaved during the run. Verdicts persist in MongoDB but are isolated per archive_id and not reused.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_cortex_backend.py and run in ~45s end-to-end with real LLM calls. Backend hits localhost:8001 directly (faster, avoids ingress timeout). Forge deliberation can take 30-90s depending on classifier output. The frontend lobe click on /chamber/boardroom and /chamber/courtroom may need a 'force=True' click on the inner <path> rather than the outer <g> if Playwright's auto-bbox click lands outside the painted area; direct page.goto() to /chamber/{id} URL is more reliable in tests. ForgeQuadrant keyword classifier in /app/frontend/src/components/ForgeQuadrant.jsx maps 'wife/marriage/family' to courtroom and lights it up to 'LISTENING' state.
